text_en: 4) Integration of the anti-corruption vision into digital solutions : By increasing the level of transparency, impartiality and accountability, digital systems will help reduce corruption. Also, processes in the justice sector, such as examination of cases in courts will be digitized.
summary: Digital systems will help reduce corruption; justice processes such as court case examination will be digitised.
extraction_note: Court case digitisation may be a back-office sector system rather than digital government.
